Chapter 1: The Isle of Mist

In the middle of Mirror Lake a corrosive yellow mist shrouds the isle where Emperor Eledain imprisoned Azrahel Koth, immortal herald of the demon lord Sathmog. Awakened by his master's rage, the demon sorcerer has enslaved his undead jailers and summoned demons, but he cannot leave his crypt without the sword Um-Durman — the only weapon that can kill him, and now in the heroes' hands. Protected from the mist by the sword or Cadal's blessed ring, the heroes dive through a pond into caves guarded by the sea demon Akrae and the troll Okvid, then descend into a trapped labyrinth of lightning-charged doors, a riddling fire demon, deadly floor and wheel traps and skeleton hordes. In the mausoleum they must slay Azrahel Koth with Um-Durman before he seizes it and goes free.

22 scenes · 12 stat blocks · 3 maps · 10 treasure
